blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo reconhecer e produzir inversões estilísticas (Not only…, Rarely…, No sooner…than, Only when…, So…that) em textos persuasivos, como um anúncio de curso de oratória.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

items: segurar a sala por um minuto

blocks.title: Command the Room: A Course in Public Speaking
lines: **Rarely** does a course change **how you speak**. **Not only will** you structure arguments with confidence, **but you will also** master your voice, pace and silence.

**No sooner** have you **enrolled than** you receive a coach who **listens**. **Only when** you can hold a room for **sixty seconds** do we move on. **So effective** is the method **that** past participants report speaking **without notes** within weeks.
**Seldom** are places this limited, and **never** has a course been so **practical**. **Under no circumstances** will you be asked to memorise a script.

items.q: The course teaches only about structure.
items.why: Not only… but also voice, pace and silence.

items.q: Participants speak without notes within weeks.
“Rarely does a course change how you speak” means…
opts: é raro um curso mudar sua fala

head: Início da frase
Exemplo
Regra
rows: **Rarely does** a course change how you speak.
**Not only will** you structure arguments, **but** also…
**No sooner have** you enrolled **than** you receive…
**Only when** you can… **do we** move on.

blocks.body: Quando um **advérbio negativo ou restritivo** abre a frase, o **auxiliar vem antes do sujeito**: *Rarely does a course…*. Sem auxiliar, use *do/does/did*.
Não inverta depois de **but also**: *Not only will you…, but you will also…* (a segunda parte é normal).

items.s: ___ does a course change how you speak. (rarely)
No sooner have you enrolled ___ you receive a coach. (than)
Only when you can hold a room ___ we move on. (do)
Under no ___ will you memorise a script. (circumstances)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: Do I have to memorise a script

body: **No sooner said than done** — dito e feito
**Not only… but also** — não só… mas também
**Do I have to memorise a script?** — Preciso decorar um roteiro?
**Then I’d like to enrol.** — Então quero me matricular.
**Not only will you structure arguments, but you will also master silence.** — Você não só estruturará argumentos, como dominará o silêncio.

blocks.task: Write a 5-sentence advertisement for a workshop, with Rarely, Not only…but also, No sooner…than and Under no circumstances.
blocks.model: Rarely does a workshop deliver so much so quickly. Not only will you plan your talk, but you will also rehearse it. No sooner have you arrived than you start speaking. Under no circumstances will you read from slides. Only when you are ready do we film you.

items.q: What does “command of the room” mean?
items.why: **command of the room** = domínio da sala.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
